page.overview:
Who is Beta?

Beta is a femalehttps://youtu.be/hLqRCaHT6FM?si=ubEytAIHrqUavl4b

(At 1:30) "Cite that on the wiki" -james juvenile Velociraptor and the sole offspring of Blue, who made her debut in as the tritagonist. Henry Wu explains that Beta was born asexually due to the monitor lizard DNA in Blue's genetic makeup.

About the size of the real life Velociraptor, Beta looks and supposedly acts like a younger and smaller version of her mother, Blue. Her snout is stubbier than her mother, and she has slightly bigger eyes. She has a chipped sickle claw on her right foot.

Beta makes a loud, yapping noise akin to a puppy.
